title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: insights on matching users left out of a policy's scope
notes: claim 46: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
claim 47: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says a policy's scope changes only when an administrator accepts a recommendation, although Microsoft documents other ways to update scoped users. It also promises that nothing changes automatically despite reporting the arrival default as unknown, and omits the requirement that a policy be active and not updating before administrators act on recommendations.
